title: FstabResult
description:
`recfstab --json`: the entries for what is mounted under the root, what the
target's fstab holds now, and (with `--write`) whether they were written.

existing.description: The fstab's active lines; empty when it has none or does not exist.

warnings.description: Things to look at before booting the target; none stops `--write`.

written.description: `--write` appended the entries (replacing conflicting lines with `--replace`).

ExistingEntry.description: An active line already in the target's fstab.

conflicts.description: Describes a mount point (or swap) that a generated entry also describes.

FstabEntry.description: One line `recfstab` writes, and the mount it describes.

file.description: The mount point, relative to the root; `none` for swap.

origin.description: What is mounted (the device, or the swap file's path on the live system).

text.description: The entry as written, its comment line included.
